title: Antimatter Propulsion
description: Antiprotons meeting hydrogen turn their whole mass into energy: charged pions leaving at near the speed of light, which a magnetic nozzle can turn into thrust. A plasma-core engine of this kind would have a specific impulse in the tens of thousands of seconds: a gram of antiprotons holds the energy of forty kilotons. Unlocks the Antimatter Injector.

puzzle.goal: An antiproton meets a proton and both vanish into energy. Write the energy E released when a mass m of antimatter annihilates with as much matter, with c the speed of light.
puzzle.name: Annihilation
puzzle.ask: Find E in TJ for m = @{m} g (give J ÷ 1e12, with m in kg and c = 3e8 m/s).
puzzle.method: E = mc² for each: the antimatter and the matter it meets, both turned wholly into energy.
